plainTranslation: Their Moon in your 4th house: instant emotional home - you nurture each other and it feels ancestral, like you've always known them. Strong family and domestic potential. Failure mode: regressing into old family patterns together. Build a new home, don't repeat the old one.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
